method.method_draft: Read the graph as distance in miles versus time in minutes. From the dashed Naomi journey, identify that Naomi reaches the beach at the point (10 minutes, 6 miles). From the solid Maya journey, identify that Maya reaches the beach at the point (30 minutes, 6 miles). Use the text to confirm the destination is 6 miles away and that the requested quantity is the difference in average speeds in miles per hour. Convert times to hours: 10 minutes = 1/6 hour and 30 minutes = 1/2 hour. Compute average speeds: Naomi = 6 ÷ (1/6) = 36 mph, Maya = 6 ÷ (1/2) = 12 mph. Subtract to get 24 mph.
